description: Set (or clear) the monthly spend limit on AI usage credits — the ceiling on how much of the prepaid balance may be consumed per calendar month (resets the 1st, UTC). Pass a USD amount to cap spending, or null to remove the cap (unlimited). Idempotent: setting the same value twice is a no-op.

monthlyLimitUsd.description: Monthly USD cap on prepaid-balance draw-down, or null for no limit (unlimited).

name: set_ai_usage_limit
